Goblin London
scripts.source:
local function finite(value, minimum, maximum)
  return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= minimum and value <= maximum
end
local function state(values, status)
  return {status = status, actions = {{type = "patchState", values = values}}}
end
local function announce(event, phrase, cooldown)
  local now = event.timestampMilliseconds
  local previous = context.state.lastSpokenMilliseconds or 0
  if context.state.alerted then return {status = "Already announced; waiting to rearm"} end
  if finite(previous, 1, now) and now - previous < cooldown then return {status = "Speech cooldown active"} end
  local reply = context.request({type = "speechSpeak", text = phrase, language = "en-GB", timeoutMilliseconds = 20000})
  if reply.type ~= "result" or not reply.result or reply.result.state ~= "spoken" then
    return {status = "Speech failed: " .. tostring(reply.code or "unverified")}
  end
  return state({alerted = true, lastSpokenMilliseconds = now}, "Spoken: " .. phrase)
end

local LONDON_LATITUDE = 51.5074
local LONDON_LONGITUDE = -0.1278
local EARTH_RADIUS_KILOMETRES = 6371
local ENTER_KILOMETRES = 20
local EXIT_KILOMETRES = 25
local MAXIMUM_ACCURACY_METRES = 500
local COOLDOWN_MILLISECONDS = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000
function on_event(event)
  local p = event.payload
  if event.type ~= "location" or not finite(event.timestampMilliseconds, 1, 10000000000000)
      or not finite(p.latitude, -90, 90) or not finite(p.longitude, -180, 180)
      or not finite(p.accuracy, 0, MAXIMUM_ACCURACY_METRES) then
    return {status = "Waiting for an accurate precise GPS fix"}
  end
  local latitude = math.rad(p.latitude)
  local delta_latitude = math.rad(p.latitude - LONDON_LATITUDE)
  local delta_longitude = math.rad(p.longitude - LONDON_LONGITUDE)
  local chord = math.sin(delta_latitude / 2)^2 + math.cos(latitude) * math.cos(math.rad(LONDON_LATITUDE)) * math.sin(delta_longitude / 2)^2
  local distance = 2 * EARTH_RADIUS_KILOMETRES * math.asin(math.sqrt(math.min(1, math.max(0, chord))))
  if distance >= EXIT_KILOMETRES then return state({alerted = false}, "Outside London; rearmed") end
  if distance > ENTER_KILOMETRES then return {status = "London boundary buffer"} end
  return announce(event, "God save the Queen! The goblin has arrived in London.", COOLDOWN_MILLISECONDS)
end

scripts.source:
local function finite(value, minimum, maximum)
  return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= minimum and value <= maximum
end
local function state(values, status)
  return {status = status, actions = {{type = "patchState", values = values}}}
end
local function announce(event, phrase, cooldown)
  local now = event.timestampMilliseconds
  local previous = context.state.lastSpokenMilliseconds or 0
  if context.state.alerted then return {status = "Already announced; waiting to rearm"} end
  if finite(previous, 1, now) and now - previous < cooldown then return {status = "Speech cooldown active"} end
  local reply = context.request({type = "speechSpeak", text = phrase, language = "en-GB", timeoutMilliseconds = 20000})
  if reply.type ~= "result" or not reply.result or reply.result.state ~= "spoken" then
    return {status = "Speech failed: " .. tostring(reply.code or "unverified")}
  end
  return state({alerted = true, lastSpokenMilliseconds = now}, "Spoken: " .. phrase)
end

local THRESHOLD_CELSIUS = 35
local RESET_CELSIUS = 32
local MAXIMUM_WEATHER_AGE_MILLISECONDS = 60 * 60 * 1000
local CLOCK_SKEW_MILLISECONDS = 60000
local COOLDOWN_MILLISECONDS = 30 * 60 * 1000
function on_event(event)
  local p = event.payload
  local now = event.timestampMilliseconds
  if event.type ~= "goblin.weather" or not finite(now, 1, 10000000000000)
      or not finite(p.temperatureC, -90, 65)
      or not finite(p.observedAtMilliseconds, now - MAXIMUM_WEATHER_AGE_MILLISECONDS, now + CLOCK_SKEW_MILLISECONDS) then
    return {status = "Waiting for fresh outdoor Celsius weather"}
  end
  if p.temperatureC < RESET_CELSIUS then return state({alerted = false}, "Below 32 Celsius; rearmed") end
  if p.temperatureC <= THRESHOLD_CELSIUS then return {status = "Below the 35 Celsius trigger"} end
  return announce(event, "It's hotter than Satan's armpit. The goblin is being slow cooked!", COOLDOWN_MILLISECONDS)
end

scripts.source:
local function finite(value, minimum, maximum)
  return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= minimum and value <= maximum
end
local function state(values, status)
  return {status = status, actions = {{type = "patchState", values = values}}}
end
local function announce(event, phrase, cooldown)
  local now = event.timestampMilliseconds
  local previous = context.state.lastSpokenMilliseconds or 0
  if context.state.alerted then return {status = "Already announced; waiting to rearm"} end
  if finite(previous, 1, now) and now - previous < cooldown then return {status = "Speech cooldown active"} end
  local reply = context.request({type = "speechSpeak", text = phrase, language = "en-GB", timeoutMilliseconds = 20000})
  if reply.type ~= "result" or not reply.result or reply.result.state ~= "spoken" then
    return {status = "Speech failed: " .. tostring(reply.code or "unverified")}
  end
  return state({alerted = true, lastSpokenMilliseconds = now}, "Spoken: " .. phrase)
end

local THRESHOLD_KMH = 80
local RESET_KMH = 65
local MAXIMUM_ACCURACY_METRES = 100
local COOLDOWN_MILLISECONDS = 15 * 60 * 1000
function on_event(event)
  local p = event.payload
  if event.type ~= "location" or not finite(event.timestampMilliseconds, 1, 10000000000000)
      or not finite(p.speed, 0, 120) or not finite(p.accuracy, 0, MAXIMUM_ACCURACY_METRES) then
    return {status = "Waiting for a valid GPS speed and accuracy"}
  end
  local speed = p.speed * 3.6
  if speed < RESET_KMH then return state({alerted = false}, "Below 65 km/h; rearmed") end
  if speed <= THRESHOLD_KMH then return {status = "Below the 80 km/h trigger"} end
  return announce(event, "Slow down! Your shit is about to come out of your arse!", COOLDOWN_MILLISECONDS)
end
